1. Umm...
2. Like...
3. You know...
4. Basically...
5. So... (used excessively)
6. Kind of...
7. Really... (used excessively)
8. I think... (often assumed)
9. That's weird...
10. That's cool...
11. It's awesome...
12. It's stupid...
13. It's funny...
14. It's embarrassing...
15. It's obvious...

These words can be used sparingly in conversation, but when used frequently, they can distract from the clarity and impact of your message. In academic writing, it's especially important to avoid these filler words to maintain a professional and precise tone. Happy studying!
